Digital Assistant · AI says:

If you’d like to exchange an item, this is how it works based on how you purchased it:

In‑store purchase: Bring the item and proof of purchase into any of our stores within the eligible return period. Our team can process an exchange, refund, or store credit, provided the item is in original condition with tags attached.
Endless Aisle (paid in store, shipped to you): These must also be returned in store. The item needs to be in original, unwashed condition with all labels and swing tags attached. Our store team can then arrange an exchange (or other remedy under our standard returns policy).
Online purchase (change of mind): You can return within 30 days of delivery if the item is in original, unwashed condition with all labels and swing tags attached. Use our online returns process/portal and select an exchange as your preferred resolution, if available.

All exchanges depend on the item meeting our condition requirements and stock availability.

turns.replyTail:
· AI says:

We do have multi-item discounts, but they’re specific, not just “any smaller item.”

Top + Bottom Save $50: One full-price top + one full-price pant (trouser, chino or Barkers denim).
Top + Bottom + Jacket Save $100: One full-price top, one full-price pant + one full-price jacket/coat/blazer/suit jacket.

Discounts are off original full prices and not with other offers.
